verdict.rationale: GitCafe can import GitHub issues and keep them in sync one way or both ways (gitcafe-docs-6, gitcafe-docs-7). That means issues from an external GitHub tracker can be worked on inside GitCafe's own issue tooling, with labels and milestones (gitcafe-docs-29). However, GitHub is the only external source evidenced, and it is a full-repo sync rather than a dedicated issue-tracker integration. Missing for 10: integrations with dedicated external trackers (e.g. Jira, Linear), documentation of in-UI linking or management of external tracker items, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bidirectional issue sync.
